task_context: The meme may or may not contain abusive language or abusive framing. Describe objective evidence only, without deciding whether it is abusive.
evidence_focus: Bengali, Bangla-English, Hindi, Urdu, or English visible text, transliteration when useful, and English meaning
insults, profanity, slurs, mocking expressions, demeaning comparisons, aggressive wording, threats, or humiliating tone
religious, gender, political, national, regional, ethnic, social, occupational, or other group references
named people, public figures, groups, communities, or social sub-groups mentioned or implied
local cultural references, films, celebrities, political references, regional identity terms, or idioms needed to understand the meme
benign or non-attacking readings when the meme appears to be ordinary humor or neutral commentary
